keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Dominik Greif (Lyon).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lille 0, Lyon 1. Mads Bidstrup (Lyon) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Lille. Ayase Ueda replaces Soriba Diaoune.
Delay in match because of an injury Tanguy Nianzou (Lille).
Substitution, Lille. Maxima Goffi replaces Tanguy Nianzou because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lille. Ethan Mbappé replaces Dilane Bakwa.
Substitution, Lyon. Nicolás Tagliafico replaces Abner Vinícius.
Substitution, Lyon. Ruben Kluivert replaces Zachary Athekame.
Substitution, Lille. Calvin Verdonk replaces Romain Perraud.
Substitution, Lille. Olivier Giroud replaces Ngal'ayel Mukau.
Substitution, Lyon. Julien Duranville replaces Keito Nakamura.
Substitution, Lyon. Kaïl Boudache replaces Ernest Nuamah.
Substitution, Lyon. Noah Nartey replaces Khalis Merah.
Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is shown the yellow card.
